GROK 4.5 RANKS #1 FOR REAL-WORLD CODING QUALITY AND POLISH

In a direct head-to-head test where Grok 4.5, Fable 5, and GPT 5.5 were given the exact same prompt to build a game, Grok 4.5 came out on top for overall quality and finish.

Results:
•  Grok 4.5: 9/10 — Delivered a genuinely polished, production-like game experience
•  Fable 5: 7.5/10
•  GPT 5.5: 7/10
The other two models produced results that felt rushed and incomplete, while Grok 4.5 stood out for cleaner execution, better structure, and overall refinement.
This wasn’t a traditional synthetic benchmark — it was a practical test focused on real developer output quality. Grok 4.5’s ability to generate more finished, higher-quality results in the same conditions highlights a meaningful strength beyond raw benchmark scores.
